CTA: Download the checklist now and start clarifying your processes!
acceptance_criteria: Achieve a minimum of 500 checklist downloads within the campaign period.
Ensure at least 30% of users engage with the follow-up content.
Gather qualitative feedback from at least 50 users on the checklist's usefulness.
audience: Small-business owners managing disconnected software, manual processes, and inconsistent follow-up.

channel_strategy.email: Targeted campaigns to existing contacts with a focus on the checklist.
channel_strategy.facebook: Engaging posts and community discussions around operational challenges.
channel_strategy.instagram: Visual stories highlighting checklist benefits and user experiences.
channel_strategy.linkedin: Professional articles and posts discussing operational efficiency.
channel_strategy.tiktok: Quick tips on identifying operational issues and using the checklist.
channel_strategy.x: Updates and insights on operational best practices.
channel_strategy.youtube: Short videos explaining how to use the checklist effectively.

creative_requirements.email_templates: Design engaging and informative email templates.
creative_requirements.landing_page: Develop a user-friendly landing page for checklist download.
creative_requirements.social_media_graphics: Create eye-catching visuals for all platforms.
creative_requirements.video_content: Produce short, informative videos for YouTube and TikTok.

customer_problem: Operational friction is spread across tools and tasks, making the next improvement hard to see.

funnel_structure.bottom_of_funnel: Action through follow-up emails encouraging checklist usage and process identification.
funnel_structure.middle_of_funnel: Engagement via informative content and checklist download.
funnel_structure.top_of_funnel: Awareness through social media posts and email campaigns.

limitations: Internal certification constraints limit external partnerships.
No GoClear assets or copy can be used.
No deceptive claims can be made in messaging.
No paid media can be utilized for promotion.
No customer data can be accessed or used.

measurement_plan.landing_page_CTA_event: Monitor engagement metrics on the landing page.
measurement_plan.measurement_receipt: Collect data on user interactions and feedback post-download.
measurement_plan.qualified_checklist_click: Track the number of downloads of the checklist.

message_hierarchy.primary_message: Streamline your operations with our free checklist.
message_hierarchy.secondary_message: Identify and clarify one process to enhance your business efficiency.
message_hierarchy.supporting_message: Take control of your operations and reduce overwhelm.

offer_framing: A free, actionable Small Business Operations Checklist designed to help you pinpoint and address operational disconnects.
positioning: The go-to resource for small-business owners seeking to simplify their operations and improve follow-up processes.
